Class LessonsLearnedList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList
public class LessonsLearnedList extends Object

Title: LessonsLearnedList Class

Description: This LessonsLearnedList class holds a collection of LessonsLearned objects. It can hold every lesson stored in the system (the persistent list of all lessons learned) or any subset of them, such as the lessons owned by one contributor or the lessons that match a keyword search. A list may be empty, may contain one or more lessons, and has no fixed upper limit on the number of lessons it can hold. The list supports Create, Read, Update, and Delete both in memory and, through the Database, persistently.

  • Constructor Details

    • LessonsLearnedList

      public LessonsLearnedList()

      Method: LessonsLearnedList()

      Description: This constructor establishes an empty list. An empty list is a valid result (e.g., a contributor who has not added any lessons), so callers never receive null.

    • LessonsLearnedList

      public LessonsLearnedList(List<LessonsLearned> lessons)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList(List<LessonsLearned> lessons)

      Description: This constructor establishes a list holding a copy of the given lessons. Copying protects this list from later changes made to the caller's list. Null entries are skipped, and a null argument produces an empty list.

      Parameters:
      lessons - specifies the lessons this list should hold

  • Method Details

    • loadAll

      public static LessonsLearnedList loadAll(Database database)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList loadAll(Database database)

      Description: Builds the persistent list of all lessons learned in the system, in title order, by reading them from the database. This is the full list from which every subset is drawn.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      Returns:
      a list of every stored lesson; empty (never null) if there are none

    • loadForContributor

      public static LessonsLearnedList loadForContributor(Database database, String username)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList loadForContributor(Database database, String username)

      Description: Builds the subset of lessons a contributor is allowed to see: only the lessons that contributor added, including any a curator has since edited (Contributor stories 2 and 4). Lessons added by other contributors are never included.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      username - is the logged-in contributor's username
      Returns:
      that contributor's lessons; empty (never null) if there are none

    • addLesson

      public Database.LessonResult addLesson(Database database, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: LessonResult addLesson(Database database, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: Stores a new lesson in the database and, only if that succeeds, adds it to this list. The Database validates the lesson first, so an invalid lesson is never stored or added; the specific message is in LessonRecognizer.lessonRecognizerErrorMessage.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      lesson - is the new lesson; its owner is the contributor adding it
      Returns:
      SUCCESS, INVALID_INPUT, or DATABASE_ERROR

    • updateLesson

      public Database.LessonResult updateLesson(Database database, LessonsLearned lesson, String actingUser)

      Method: LessonResult updateLesson(Database database, LessonsLearned lesson, String actingUser)

      Description: Saves an edited lesson to the database and, if that succeeds, replaces the lesson in this list with the stored version. If the database refuses the update (invalid input, not found, not the owner, or locked), this list is left unchanged.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      lesson - holds the edited values and the ID of the lesson to change
      actingUser - is the username of the contributor making the change
      Returns:
      the Database's result (SUCCESS or the reason the update was refused)

    • deleteLesson

      public Database.LessonResult deleteLesson(Database database, int lessonId, String actingUser, boolean confirmed)

      Method: LessonResult deleteLesson(Database database, int lessonId, String actingUser, boolean confirmed)

      Description: Deletes a lesson from the database and, if that succeeds, removes it from this list. The confirmed parameter carries the user's answer to "Are you sure?"; a "No" answer changes nothing.

      Parameters:
      database - is the application's Database
      lessonId - is the database ID of the lesson to delete
      actingUser - is the username of the contributor requesting the delete
      confirmed - is true only when the user answered "Yes"
      Returns:
      the Database's result (SUCCESS, CANCELLED, or the reason the delete was refused)

    • search

      public LessonsLearnedList search(String keywords)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList search(String keywords)

      Description: Builds a new list holding the lessons in this list that match every keyword. A keyword matches when it appears anywhere in the lesson's title, category, situation, or lesson text, ignoring upper and lower case. Keywords are separated by spaces. A blank or null search returns a copy of this whole list. This list is not changed, and the result may be empty.

      Parameters:
      keywords - specifies one or more keywords separated by spaces
      Returns:
      a new LessonsLearnedList containing the matching subset

      Returns:

      public boolean add(LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: boolean add(LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: Adds a lesson to the end of this list in memory only. Null is rejected so every element in the list is always a real lesson. To store a new lesson, use addLesson().

      Parameters:
      lesson - specifies the lesson to be added
      Returns:
      true if the lesson was added, else false (the lesson was null)
